(2) The woman moves her mouth as if speaking while smiling broadly and gesturing with the product box. The table holds a white tea set, a plate with a slice of pie, a bowl of cereal snacks, and a red apple. Bright studio lighting illuminates the scene uniformly. (3) Two men appear on either side of the woman at the same yellow table. One man on the left has long dark hair and wears a white jacket. The man on the right wears glasses and holds a large blue shark-shaped toy gun, pointing it forward. (4) A horizontal split-screen transition occurs. In the top frame, the long-haired man leans toward the woman with a whispering posture. In the bottom frame, the man with glasses maintains a serious facial expression while holding the toy gun steady. (5) High-angle close-ups display blue and orange "Universe Magic Soldier" snack boxes. The scene shifts to show pink and yellow snack pouches being tilted, with cashew nuts falling into a yellow bowl against a two-tone pink and yellow background. (6) The screen transitions to a white background. A minimalist black line-art logo of a head with a speech bubble appears in the center, accompanied by Traditional Chinese text below it.
